giver: Village watch: guards (Guard Villagers) in every village (pooled representatives); in Reece, Captain Hale of the watch, and Sergeant Brannock, its oldest guard.
feel: Guarding villages and holding the line: night watches, walls and garrisons, scouting and breaking illager strongholds, surviving raids at the gate, and a last stand at the end of the world.

quests.title: Enlist
quests.summary: Captain Hale in Reece enlists anyone who turns up with a shield: craft one and swear to the watch.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a watch tabard (leather chestplate, dyed)

quests.title: First Night on the Wall
quests.summary: Stand the gate of Reece from dusk to dawn beside the guards; not a single villager may fall.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a basic Spartan shield

quests.title: Weak Spots
quests.summary: Walk the village edge with Sergeant Brannock and fix what he points at: a gap in the fence, a dark lane without torches, a door with no lock.
quests.reward: Defense XP, lanterns and fence gates

quests.title: Arm the Watch
quests.summary: A village has no guards at all; give a willing villager a sword to make a guard, then arm a second with a crossbow and armour.

quests.title: Behind the Wall of Iron
quests.summary: Brannock fights behind a tower shield: craft an iron one and block a hundred hits with it.
quests.reward: Defense XP, an iron tower shield banner

quests.title: Eyes on the Outpost
quests.summary: Pillagers have been seen on the roads. Find their outpost and count the crossbows from cover without being spotted.

quests.title: At the Gate
quests.summary: The pillagers come. Stand at the village gate through the whole raid with the guards and keep the villagers alive; afterwards Brannock gives you the crystal heart he wore through forty years of raids.

quests.title: The Cold Caster
quests.summary: A snowy village is freezing under ice-chunk storms; track the iceologer back to its cabin and end it.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a totem of freezing

quests.title: The Pilgrim's Road
quests.summary: An old priest appears on the road, set on reaching a distant chapel through bandit country. Keep him alive all the way; at the altar he gives you the necklace he prayed with.

quests.title: Which One Is Real?
quests.summary: At the illusioner's training grounds, a dozen copies attack at once; find the real illusioner and break the spell.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a totem of illusion

quests.title: The Walled Town
quests.summary: Captain Hale wants plans for Reece's walls; travel to a fortified village, bring its watch captain iron, and copy how the walls are built.

quests.title: Walls for Reece
quests.summary: Raise a stone wall and a gatehouse on Reece's open side from the plans, and post two iron golems at the gate.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a diamond basic shield

quests.title: The Stray Fort
quests.summary: Strays from a fort in the snow keep shooting at travellers; storm the stray fort and take its banner.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a stack of tipped arrows

quests.title: The Thornborn Towers
quests.summary: A shrine choked by thorns has become a nest; fight through the Thornborn Towers and clear what lives inside. A pendant of thorns lies on the altar.

quests.title: Struck Again
quests.summary: The engineers' tower that draws lightning away from a village has burnt out. In a thunderstorm, climb it and replace its copper lightning rods while bolts keep striking, with a copper golem's help.

quests.title: Raiders from the Sea
quests.summary: Coastal villages are raided from the water; sail out and take the pillager ship that launches them.

quests.title: The Illager Manor
quests.summary: The raiders' captives are held at an illager manor in a dark forest; break in, free the villagers and walk them home.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a netherite upgrade template

quests.title: Hold the Bridge
quests.summary: Ravagers are coming over the only bridge to a village. Hold the middle of it for the full count without being knocked off; the bridge-keeper's spiked boots are the thanks.

quests.title: Fire at the Forge
quests.summary: A Wildfire and its blazes come up through a ruined portal and go for a village's forge. Hold the forge until they're beaten; the smith forges you a pendant from the Wildfire's crown.

quests.title: Across the Lava
quests.summary: A guard of the watch is held captive in a Nether keep across a lava lake; bridge the lava, break in and bring him out. He gives you the obsidian skull he carried for luck.

quests.title: The Illagers' Seat
quests.summary: All the raids answer to the woodland mansion; go in and kill its evokers to break their command.

quests.title: The Great Raid
quests.summary: In revenge, the illagers send their largest raid at a fortified village; hold it through every wave, ravagers and all, with its guards.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a stack of emeralds from grateful villagers

quests.title: Netherite Wall
quests.summary: Forge a netherite tower shield and a full set of netherite armour for what Hale fears is coming.

quests.title: Stand at World's End
quests.summary: Hale's scouts are trapped at an End city's foot; hold the island against endermen and shulkers until they're out. The watch's last-resort relic, the chorus totem, is yours afterwards.

quests.title: Take Back the Village
quests.summary: A desert village has been taken by koboletons and their Kobolediator; drive them out and give the villagers their homes back.

quests.title: The Village That Fell
quests.summary: Not every village was saved: walk the abandoned village Cataclysm's monsters left, and bring its broken watch bell to Reece as a reminder.

quests.title: Captain of the Watch
quests.summary: Hale hangs up his sword and names you Captain of the Watch, handing over the shield that has stood at Reece's gate since it was founded.
quests.reward: Defense XP, the Bulwark of Reece (netherite tower shield: Unbreaking III, Mending)
